<p><strong>Lifestyle inflation</strong>:
Lifestyle inflation ndi musi u engedzwa ha mvelelo kunwe na kunwe ku tshi fanyiswa na u engedzwa ha u shanduka. Vha wana zwinshi fhedzi a vha fhaṱi thundu. Sipho u wana R20k a fhedza R19k; o bveleliswa u swika R30k, u khwinisa ṋumba, koloi na dzisubscription zwi tshi ita uri a fhedze R29k. U kha ḓi boloka R1k fhedzi.

Tshigogo ndi mulayo wo tiwaho na u ranga: musi mufumahali a tshi swika, boloka u fhira ha tshipida tsha u engedzwa vha sa athu khwinisa zwinwe. Thundu dzi dzhena vhukati ha zwine vha wana na zwine vha fhedza, tsireledzani vhukati.
<p><strong>Loss aversion</strong> is the:
Loss aversion ndi maanḓa mahulu a u fhedzisela kha behavioral finance. Vhaṋewa-maano Kahneman na Tversky vho wana uri vhuṱungu ha u felwa nga R100 vhu lingana na u ṋea kavhili ha maanḓa ha u takala ha u wana R100.

U sa fana uku ku ita uri vhathu vha vha na maano a u sa vhona vhuimo ha khedzi:

  • U fara vhubindudzi vho felwaho lwa tshikhala tshilapfu, vha tshi khou lavhelela 'u vhuyela' vha sa athu rengisa
  • U rengisa vhubindudzi vho mfelelaho lwa u tavhanya u 'vha na mvelelo' vha sa athu fhela
  • U sendedza vhubindudzi vhune ha shanduka, naho mvelelo dza tshikhala tshilapfu dzi tshi ḓo vha nṱha
  • U sa fanyisa vhubindudzi ngauri zwi amba u ḓivha u felwa

<p><strong>Mental accounting</strong> is:
Mental accounting ndi u dzhia madi ṋila yo fhamba-fhambanaho u bva kha zwine zwa bva hone kana tshipikwa, naho madi e ṅwe fhedzi (ranti iwe i fana na iwe ranti inwe na inwe).

Tsumbo dzo ḓoweleaho:

  • U badela tshibentshela kha kiredi card vhukati ha u vha na mivhalelo i re kha akhaunthu ya tshibentshela tshiṱuku ('madi ayo ndi a zwiimo zwi sa ḓivhiwaho')
  • U dzhia mibuelo ya u beba sa 'madi a mahala' a u fhedzwa zwi sa tendelwi
  • U sa ṋea madi fhedzi na u vha mahala na kiredi card ('a zwi vhonwi sa madi a vhukokodzi')

Mental accounting ndi yone ine ya ita uri vhathu vhafare koloi i duraho na u vhalela mivhalelo ya tshibentshela tshiṱuku, u sa fana na mathobho a mathayo.

Mental accounting ndi u dzhia madi ṋila yo fhamba-fhambanaho u bva kha hune ya bva hone. Bonus i fhedzwa vhegeni iwe mufumahali wa vhuhulu ha u fana u vhalelwa zwavhuḓi. <p><strong>Overconfidence bias:</strong>:
Overconfidence bias: Vhathu vhanzhi vha vhalela u khou kaira, u ita vhubindudzi, na u dzhia maano sa 'zwi re nṱha ha vhukati', zwi sa konḓi kha vhanzhi. Kha vhubindudzi, overconfidence i ita u renga vhuvhili, u sa fhambana, na u dzhia khombo i fhiraho u kona kwanu.

Vhaḓivhi vha fhaṱa u sumba uri vhabilisi vha vhathu vhane vha renga zwi sa fheli vha fhedzisela vho ṋewa mvelelo dzavhi, ngauri mitengo ya zwiito na maano a u renga nga nṱha/u renga fhasi zwi katelwa tshifhingani. Vhabilisi vha sa shumi (vha sa itI tshithu) vha fhedzisela vho bvelela u fhira vha renga vha tshi khou shuma.

Recency bias: Ngele i vhalela zwiite zwa zwino na u humbulela uri zwiimo zwa zwino zwi ḓo ḓi bvela phindeni. Murahu ha miṅwaha ya 3 ya mvelelo dza JSE, vhabilisi vha lavhelela mvelelo dza nṱha. Murahu ha u wa, vha lavhelela u wa ho engedzwaho. Mbudziso dzoṱhe dzi si zwivhi u fhira zwi zwivhi.

Hindsight bias i fhedzisela yo tiisa uri ro vha ri tshi zwi vhona, i tshi fhaṱa vhulunga vhu sa athu fhela. <p><strong>Treating Customers Fairly (TC: Treating Customers Fairly (TCF) ndi ṋila ya mvelelo. <p><strong>Treating Customers Fairly</st: Treating Customers Fairly i vhea mvelelo tharu. <p>A <strong>bond</strong> is a debt ins:
A bond ndi tshiiteṅwa tsha tshikolodo. Musi ni tshi renga bond, ni khou kolotisa masheleni u ya kha murengisi (mupuso kana khamphani) u furalela:

  1. Mbadelo dza nzwalelondavhelelwa (dzo vhidzwaho coupon) dza phimo ya mbuelotiwa
  2. U vhuedzedzwa tshaṹ tshikolodo tshihulwane (tshigango tshine na kolotisa) kha u fhela (ḓuvha ḽa u fhela)

Tsumbo: Ni renga R10 000 RSA Retail Bond na 10% coupon na u fhela ha miṅwaha ya 5. Ni wana R1 000/ṅwaha ya nzwalelondavhelelwa. Nga murahu ha miṅwaha ya 5, ni wana R10 000 yaṹ i tshi vhuya.

<p>A business can be profitable but have:
Khamphani i nga vha na mibuelo fhedzi ya hula tshelede ya vhukati. Ili ndi lone vhuimo vhu dowelekapo vha u wa ha SME kha SA.

Tsumbo: Khamphani ya vhubiki ya Priya i badela R500 000 Ṅwhe. Vha renga vha badela maduvha a 60 (Meyi). U badela mishumo, zwiliwa, na vhuimo zwino. Muvhuro u sumbedza R500 000 ya mibuelo. Akhaunthu ya benki i sumbedza -R200 000. U na mibuelo fhedzi tshelede i khou bva.

Mulingo wa u shandukisa tshelede: Tshifhinga tshi re vhukati ha u badela zwikili na u kuvhanganya vha renga. Tshipfupi = vhuḓi. Maitele a u pfufhisa: u humbela mbadelo ya u thoma, u ntshedza mutengo wa u badela nga u tavhanya, u lelesa mbadelo dza vha-tshelwa, u rengisa inibhosi ya vhukati.

Mulayo: Ni songo vhiganisa mibuelo ya vhudzirelwa na akhaunthu yanu ya benki. Shumisani mbalela ya vhege ya tshelede ya vhege 13 dzi tevhelaho. Arali ya vha yo bva, ni tea u ita vhukati ha miwedzi phand a sa athu vha vhulwele.
<p>A classic mental accounting error: ke:
Vhulwele ha u vhalela ha vhuvha: u vhulunga R30 000 akhaunthuni ya u vhulunga i tshi bveledza 7% ngeno u tshi di fara tshikolodo cha R30 000 kha khadi ya khredithi tsha 22%. Muhumbulo: 'A thi koni u khwaṱhisa tshelede yanga ya u vhulunga - yoyo ndi ya zwa tshidzhulumani.' Fhedzi ni khou xelelwa 15% ya mivhuro nga u fara zwithu zwivhiri nga tshifhinga tshithihi.

Maitelo a vhuḓi: shumisani tshelede ya u vhulunga u bvisa tshikolodo tsha 22%, ngeno u thoma hafhu vhulungi ha 7%. Tshikwama tsha tshidzhulumani tshi fhaṱwa hafhu kha 7% hu si u ni bvisisa 15%.

<p>A government or company bond is a loa:

<p>A growing SA scam: a 'friend' or 'inf:

<p>An overdraft lets you spend past zero: Overdraft i u tendela u fhirisa zero kha vhukati ha prime + 5–8%, na mutheo u tshi engedzea ḓuvha ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe, u fana na kana u khakha u fhira credit card. <p>Buyers will discount (lower) your ask:
Vha renga vha ḓo fhungudza mitengo yau ya red flags idzi, zwo ḽuvhwaho u sa athu u renga:

  • Key person dependency: Arali owner I vha business (vhurugi oṱhe, vhuḓivhi oṱhe), business i na ndeme ya fhasi hu si na vhone. Solution: document processes, introduce management team, create 12-month transition plan.
  • Customer concentration: Arali 60%+ ya revenue i bva kha client nthihi, buyer i renga client relationship, hu si business. Solution: diversify u sa athu u renga.
  • Unclean books: Personal expenses kha company, informal transactions, mixed accounts. Solution: 2-3 years zwo ṱolaho audited annual financial statements dzi engedza value na buyer confidence.
  • No contracts: Verbal agreements na clients kana suppliers. Buyers ṱoda contractual revenue. Solution: formalise relationships kha written agreements.

<p>Capital Gains Tax applies when you se:
Capital Gains Tax i shuma musi u tshi rengisa thundu ya nṱha ha zwe wa badela. CGT A I VHI mutheo wo fhambanaho - i shuma nga u katela tshipida cha gain kha tshibuelo chau.

Vhana vha vhathu: 40% ya gain i katelwa kha taxable income (i pfi 'inclusion rate'). Kha gain ya R100 000, R40 000 i engedzwa kha tshibuelo chau na u badelwa marginal rate. Kha 36%: effective CGT = R14 400.
<p>Capital Gains Tax is not a separate t:
Capital Gains Tax a i vhi mutheo wo fhambanaho South Africa. Ndi top-up ya income tax. Musi u tshi bvisa thundu (u renga, u ṋea, u fa, kana u emigrate), SARS i katela tshipida cha profit kha taxable income ya ṅwaha uyo.

Inclusion rates dza 2024/25:

  • Individuals: 40% ya gain i katelwa kha taxable income
  • Companies: 80% zwo katelwaho
  • Trusts: 80% zwo katelwaho (45% flat rate × 80% = effective 36%)

Individual kha 45% bracket i badela effectively 18% CGT (45% × 40%). Hu si 45%. Phambano iyi ya ndeme.
<p>Capital Gains Tax isn't a separate ta:
Capital Gains Tax a i vhi mutheo wo fhambanaho SA. Ndi top-up ya income tax. Musi u bvisa thundu (u renga, u ṋea, u emigrate, kana u fa), tshipida cha profit tshi engedzwa kha taxable income.

Individuals vha katela 40% ya gain; kha top 45% bracket ndi 18% effective rate (45% × 40%), hu si 45%. Shields mivhili i thusa: annual exclusion ya R50 000 na primary-residence exclusion ya R3 000 000 (zwo ṱangana Budget 2026).

<p>Psychological research consistently s:
Vhulangi ha maitele a vhathu vhu sumbedza uri vhathu vha shandula tshelede ya u wana zwi sa lavhelelwi (bonuses, zwibviselwa zwa tshelede zwa mutheo, masi) nga nḓila i sa luvheleli u fhira tshelede ya ngazwo, naho vha na kolomo i sa fheli kana zwiimiswa zwa u vhulunga.

Bonus ya ṅwedzi wa Ḓitimba ya R15 000 ine ya fhedzwa kha TV na vhutshilo kha vhege mbivhili a si 'tshedele i ngaho'. Ndi tshelede ine ya nga vha yo:

  • Badela khadi ya credit ka 22%
  • I tshi itwa vhubindudzi kha ETF i vha na 10%+ miṅwaha ya 20
  • I tshi fuda miṅwaha miraru ya u vhulungela khakhathi

Ndevhe: Ngeno ni sa athu u wana bonus, humbula phanḓa uri tshipida tshini tshi ya kha u badela kolomo, u vhulunga, na u shandula. u ḓivha zwenezwo phanḓa ha u swika ha tshelede zwi thivhela mbilu ya u hupula nḓila mbi.
<p>R300 000 car financed at 14% over 72: R300 000 ya goloi i badelwaho ka 14% kha miṅwaha ya 72: u badela ha ṅwedzi ≈ R6 600, tshelede yoṱhe i badelwaho ≈ R475 200, interest ya badelwaho ≈ R175 200. No badela R475 000 ya goloi ine ya vha na R90 000-R120 000 mafheloni a tshifhinga. Mutengo wa fiki wo fhirisa thungo ya goloi.
<p>R300 000 left in a preservation fund:
R300 000 i si i saselelwe kha tshikwama tsha u tsireledza ka 10% nga ṅwaha:

  • Miṅwaha mi-10: R778 000
  • Miṅwaha ya 20: R2.02 mirioni
  • Miṅwaha ya 30: R5.24 mirioni

U bvisa tshelede ka 35% ya tshelede ya mutheo i vha R195 000. No ṋekedza R5 mirioni u itela R195 000.
<p>R500 000 invested for 30 years at 10%:
R500 000 i vhubindudzi ha miṅwaha ya 30 ka 10% gross:

  • 0% fee: R8.72 mirioni
  • 0.5% fee: R7.64 mirioni (no xelelwa hi R1.08m kha fees)
  • 2% fee: R5.05 mirioni (no xelelwa hi R3.67m kha fees)

R3.67 mirioni ya mutengo wa fees i fhirisa vhubindudzi ha u thoma ha R500 000. Hezwi ndi zwine u fokoliswa ha fees zwi vhaho nḓila ya vhubindudzi i fulufhedzeaho i wanalaho.
<p>Rand weakness → higher petrol → highe: Rand ya vhuya ya fhedza → petroli ya nṱha → mutengo wa u tshimbila wa nṱha → mitengo ya nṱha ya zwiṅwe zwoṱhe zwi tshi tshimbiswa (zwiliwa, zwithu, zwibveledzwa). Hezwi ndi zwine rand i sa koni u imela zwi vhaiswa nga u huliswa ha inflation, hu si petroli fhedzi. Inflation ya zwiliwa, zwihulu, i tevhela rand nga vhutshilo ha mafhungo a u phakha.
<p>Research by Brinson, Hood, and Beebow:
Vhuṱanzi ha Brinson, Hood, na Beebower vhu sumbedza uri u fhira 90% ya vhubindudzi ha vhuphulusi ha tshifhinga tsha u leluwa zwi haseledzwa nga asset allocation, u kheana ha zwithu zwa vhubindudzi, hu si u khea share kana tshikwama tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe.

Zwithu zwihulu zwa vhubindudzi zwa muveli wa SA:

  • Equities (shares): Vhubindudzi ha tshifhinga tsha u leluwa tsha nṱha, u sa dzikisa ha tshifhinga tshipfufhi tsha nṱha. JSE, shares dza shango łoṱhe.
  • Bonds (fixed income): Vhubindudzi ha vhukati, u sa dzikisa ha fhasi. Government na corporate bonds.
  • Property (REITs): Tshelede i vhuya + mvelaphanda ya tshelede. Retail, ofisi, industrial property.
  • Cash: Mutengo wa fhasi, u sa dzikisa ho vha zero. Money market, fixed deposits.
  • Alternatives: Commodities, hedge funds (huna vhane vha nga sa swikeleleka kha vhubindudzi).

U kheana ha vhuvhi zwi ya ya nga tshifhinga tsha anu na vhutshilo ha vhushaka, hu si maitele a marakethe ṋamusi.
<p>Research on genuinely wealthy people:
Vhuṱanzi ha vhathu vha pfuma vhukuma (The Millionaire Next Door, Stop Acting Rich) vhu sumbedza uri: vhathu vhanzhi vha vha pfuma vha khou vha na goloi dza vhukati, vha dzula masi a u leluwa, vha xela madzulongoni a u leluwa, na u sa vha na u divhatedza zwa vhutshilo.

Pfuma na u sumbedza pfuma zwi ya vhambana nga vhuṱalo. Vhane vha vha na pfuma nṱha ha zwithu zwa vhuambani vha vha vhathu vha sa pfumaho vhukuma.
<p>Retail cards tempt you with instant a:
Khedi dza vhengele dzi ni vhidza nga u tendelwa nga u kgafula na u fhungudzelwa zwa ṅwaha wa mibebelo. Khadi ya credit i nga thusa cash flow arali na badela zwoṱhe zwa ṅwedzi na arali mibuelo i tshi fhirisa fees. Vhulwele vhu thoma arali mbadelo ya u shandukisa i sangana na 20%+ rate, nahone R2 500 ya u phakhela i sala miṅwaha.

Nḓila ya vhutshilo: u songo vhuya na autopay fhedzi minimum arali ni sa dzuli muṅwaho wa u vhulungela khakhathi, na u xela tap-to-pay kha akayawunthu ine na sa koni u i tevhela vhege ya vhuṱanu.
<p>Retailers design stores and apps to m:
Vhavhi vha vhengele vha dzudzha madzulo na apps u bveledza u renga ku sa lavhelelwi. Mitshimbilo ya checkout, 'limited-time' deals, 'customers also bought', '70% off today only' - zwoṱhe zwo itelwa u fhirisa u humbula ha vhuṱali.

U renga kha internet ndi kũkhuhu: mbadelo dza one-click dza u leluwa, zwiambani zwa vhathu, na zwifhinga zwa u balala zwi engedza u renga ku sa lavhelelwi vhukuma.
<p>Retirement contributions are deductib: Mbadelo dza u humela u ya phanḓa dza vhuphulusi dzi bviswa u swika kha 27.5% ya tshelede i sa athu u huliswa, i swika R430 000 nga ṅwaha, tshibveledzwa tshihulu tsha mulayo tshine vhashumeli vhanzhi vha vha nacho. Mibuelo ya vhulungisi ha vhathu vha mushumo i vha na vhuṱali ha vhuṅwe. Zwoṱhe hezwi ndi u vha kule na tshelede ya mutheo: mulayo u ya tendela. U fela tshelede ya mutheo ndi vhugevhenga, nahone zwi mulandu.
<p>Retirement funds (pension, provident,:
Tshikwama tsha vhuphulusi (pension, provident, RA) zwi langwa nga Pension Funds Act Section 37C. Bodo ya vhalangi ya tshikwama tsha anu i fanela u humbula vhane vha khou dzula nga ngeno zwi tshi kwama tshelede, hu si vhane na vha khea fhedzi.

Arali na khea musadzi/munna wanu fhedzi ngeno ni na vhana vhararu vha vhaṱuku vhane vha sa athu u hula vhane vha dzula nga ngeno zwi tshi kwama tshelede ya anu, vhalangi vha nga phaka tshipida tsha tshelede kha vhana vhenevho naho zwo ita hani.

Nḓila ya vhutshilo: Reba vhane vha vha na vhutshilo hune vha khou dzula nga ngeno zwi tshi kwama tshelede sa vhane na vha khea. Khwinifhadzani u khea ṅwaha muṅwe na muṅwe na nga murahu ha vhutshilo. Muvhalangi wa tshikwama u ṋea mafhungo a u khea, kombelani vhone ṋamusi.
<p>Retiring at 55 vs 65 has a dramatic i: U humela u ya phanḓa ka 55 vhu vhambana na 65 hu na mvelele khulu kha tshelede ya vhuphulusi ya anu. Kha 55 nioda miṅwaha ya 35-40 ya tshelede (u swika vhidzo lya 90-95). Kha 65 nioda miṅwaha ya 25-30. U humela u ya phanḓa miṅwaha 10 i takalaho zwioda tshelede ya u vhulunga i fhiraho 50% u tiya vhutshilo ho fananaho na nḓila ya u bvisa tshelede.
<p>Retiring ten years earlier hits you t: U humela u ya phanḓa miṅwaha fumi u tshi thoma zwi ni vhaisa kavhili: miṅwaha miṱuku ya u ṋea na u hula, miṅwaha minzhi ya u bvisa tshelede, na miṅwaha ya fumafuha ya u thoma u humela u ya phanḓa i engedza u fhira ya u thoma, ngauri u huliswa hu shuma kha tshelede khulwane ine na ḓo vha nayo. Nḓila dza vhukuma ndi u vhulunga zwinzhi, uoda zwiṱuku, kana u shuma ha tshifhinga tshipfufhi. Tshelede ya u thoma i fhungudza sequence risk: u bvisa tshelede tshifhinga tsha u tshinyala zwi vhaisa mvelele dza vhumatshelu.
<p>Returns are uncertain; fees are contr: Mvelele dzi na u sa homa; fees ndi dza mulayo. Tshipida tsha nṱha tsha ṅwaha tshi vhidzwa kha tshelede yoṱhe ya anu ṅwaha muṅwe na muṅwe, sa zwenezwo tshi khou ni lwisana. Kha miṅwaha ya 30, 1% ya ṅwaha i nga vha ya vhuṱala ha tshipida tsha vhuvhili tsha mutengo wa mafhelo. Under the FAIS General Code, fees na vhuavhanyi zwi fanela u haseledzwa nga ṅwalo ngeno ni sa athu u dzhenela. Vhudzisisani mutengo woṱhe wa ṅwaha kha percent na rands.
<p>Romance scams cost South Africans hun:
Vhuvevhenga ha vhutshilo vhu vhidza Vhaafrika Tshipembe ma-million nga ṅwaha. Profayili ya vhuvevhenga (kaninji i tshi shumisa zwo fatiwaho zwa vhathu vha vhuḓi) i bveledza vhushaka ha internet vhege kana miṅwaha - mbei i vhidza tshelede: khakhathi ya vhulwadze, u tshimbila u vhona, vhubindudzi, tshelede ya custom.

Vhushaka ha mbilu zwo itelwa, a si zwa vhukuma. Arali tshelede ya ṋekedzwa, u amana hu fhedza u ima lwa u thoma.

<p>SA banks offer dramatically different: Banka dza SA dzi ṋea vhubindudzi ha vhuphulusi ha u fhambana vhukuma. <p>SA factor evidence broadly mirrors gl:
Vhuṱanzi ha factor ha SA vhu vhambana na zwa shango łoṱhe:

Value kha JSE: Shares dza zwithu (Sasol, Anglo American, Exxaro) kale vha vha na P/E multiples dza fhasi nahone vha bveledza mvelele dza tshifhinga tsha u leluwa dza nṱha tshifhinga tsha zwithu tshi tshi shanduka. Value tilt kha JSE i fhirisa SWIX nga 2-3% ya ṅwaha kha miṅwaha ya 20.

Quality kha JSE: Koporasi dza u nga Capitec, Clicks, na Sanlam dzi sumbedza quality factor, ROE ya nṱha, u hula ha zwithu zwa vhuḓi, u sa vha na kolomo ya nṱha, nahone vha fhirisa index vhukuma.

Zwithu zwa vhugudi: Satrix wo thoma Quality ETF (STXQUA) na Momentum ETF (STXMOM). Ashburton Investments i ṋea Global 1200 ETF na quality screen. Hezwi zwi ṋea vhuphulusi vhubindudzi u sika factor exposure hu si na active management fees.
<p>SA is under ~0.5% of global markets,:
SA i na ~0.5% ya marakethe ya shango łoṱhe, ngazwo vhubindudzi hoṱhe ha SA ndi u vhea kha emerging market i fanaho. Offshore exposure i engedza u fhambana na rand hedge. Zwithu zwa shango łoṱhe zwi ya nṱha nge rands ya fhedza matimba.

Regulation 28 i fhungudza vhuphulusi bwa vhubindudzi (RA/pension) kha 45% offshore (u bva kha 30% ngo 2022), ngazwo fhedzi 55% i sala hayani. TFSAs na discretionary accounts a zwi na offshore limit. Ni nga ya 100% global. U bvisa tshelede nnḓa nga vhuhulu: R2 mirioni ya single discretionary allowance ya ṅwaha (i katelwaho kha Budget 2026) na R10 mirioni ya foreign investment allowance na vhulangi ha SARS.
<p>SA savings rates vary widely between: Mibuelo ya u vhulunga ya SA i fhambana vhukuma vhukati ha banka na zwibveledzwa, na vhukati vhu hula. Notice accounts dzi badela zwinzhi u fhira call accounts ngauri ni nekedza u swika hu sa fhedzi tshifhinga. Interest i vha tax-free u swika fhedzi R23 800 ya ṅwaha (R34 500 u bva 65). TFSA i bvisa tax yoṱhe. Mbadelo dzi tsireledzwa u swika R100 000 per bank nga CODI.
<p>SA store cards (Edgars, Foschini, Mar: Khedi dza vhengele dza SA (Edgars, Foschini, Markham, Truworths, RCS) dzi vhidza 21-24% ya ṅwaha - hovho vhukati ha mibuelo i tendelwaho nga mulayo. Dzi itelwe u ita uri zwiambaro zwi vhonale zwi tshi swikeleleka zwino na u duru miṅwaha i tevhelaho. Tshipida tsha mibuelo ya interest tshi ṋea vhavhi zwinzhi u fhira tshipida tsha zwiambaro.
<p>SA's current account deficit (importi:
Current account deficit ya SA (u renga zwithu zwi na mutengo u fhira zwi bviswaho) ndi nḓila ya u fhedza matimba ya rand. U badela zwithu zwiiswaho, SA i fanela u rengisa rands u renga dollars - zwi bveledza u kunga fhasi ha sa fhedzi.

Arali mitengo ya zwithu ya nṱha (gold, platinum, coal), mibuelo ya u bvisa zwithu ya SA i ya nṱha, u fhungudza current account deficit na u tikedza rand. Hezwi ndi zwine mitengo ya mining commodities na rand zwi vhambana vhukuma.
<p>SARS eFiling (efiling.sars.gov.za) an: SARS eFiling (efiling.sars.gov.za) na SARS MobiApp zwi tendela vhathu u rumela tax returns kha internet. Zwo ḓala na: IRP5 data (u bva kha mutsuri wanu), bank interest (IT3b), mbadelo dza medical aid, na mbadelo dza vhuphulusi. Langa data yoṱhe yo ḓalaho ngeno ni sa athu u rumela.
<p>SARS is explicit: crypto is a taxable: SARS i amba khagala: crypto ndi zwithu zwa tax. Capital Gains Tax i shuma arali na fara na u rengisa (40% ya gain i katelwa kha tshelede). Income tax i shuma arali na rengisa nga u fhambana. Vhulungani zwithu zwa vhushaka zwa ṅwaha muṅwe na muṅwe: ḓuvha, rand value ya u renga, rand value ya u rengisa. Ma-exchange a SA (Luno, VALR) a kovhela data na SARS.
<p>SARS provides a Medical Scheme Fees T:
SARS i ṋea Medical Scheme Fees Tax Credit (MTC) ine i fhungudza PAYE ya anu:

  • Main member: R376/month
  • First dependant: R376/month
  • Each additional dependant: R254/month

Vha vhingana vha vhulunga R752/month (R9 024/year) kha tax nga credit hei - i shumiswa nga u diitela nga mutsuri wanu kha payslip ya anu.
<p>SARS requires detailed records for al:
SARS i vhidza vhuṱanzi vhu pfufhi ha zwithu zwoṱhe zwa crypto:

  • Ḓuvha ḽa tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tsha vhushaka
  • Tshikalo (u renga/u rengisa/u shandula/mining income/staking income)
  • Mutengo kha crypto
  • Mutengo wa rand tshifhinga tsha vhushaka
  • Cost basis (mutengo wa u renga wa u thoma kha rands)
  • Exchange yo shumiswaho

Ma-exchange a u nga Luno na VALR a ṋea CSV statements dzi swikelelekhaho - dzhiani ṅwaha muṅwe na muṅwe na u dzi vhulunga.
<p>SARS takes exactly what you owe, but:
SARS i dzhia zwine na kolowa vhukuma, fhedzi a i nga ni vhudzi nga zwa nḓila dza mulayo dza u badela zwiṱuku. Vhashumeli vhane vha sa ḓivhi nga zwa RA deductions, medical credits na home-office deductions vha badela zwinzhi zwa ma-thousand ṅwaha muṅwe na muṅwe.

SA i shumisa marginal tax brackets: ni badela fhedzi rate ya nṱha kha tshelede i fhiraho threshold iṅwe na iṅwe, hu si salary yoṱhe. Kha 2026/27, vha miṅwaha ya fhasi ha 65 a vha badeli tax fhasi ha R99 000 (primary rebate ya R17 820 i i thivhela), na top marginal rate ndi 45%. Ngano ya uri u huliswa zwi nga fhungudza tshelede ya anu ya uya hayani a zwi konadzei. Ni dzula ni tshi vhulunga zwinzhi nga u wana zwinzhi.
<p>SARS taxes trusts punitively to preve:
SARS i badelisa trusts tax ya nṱha u thivhela vhathu vha pfuma u vhea tshelede kha trusts kha rates dza fhasi:

  • Tshelede i salaho kha trust: I badeliswa tax ya flat 45%, i fanaho na highest individual bracket
  • Capital gains kha trust: 80% inclusion rate × 45% = effective 36%
  • Tshelede i nekedzwaho (u bviswa) kha beneficiaries: I badeliswa tax kha vhoko ya beneficiary kha rate yayo

Tshikhala tsha u dzudzha: Arali ni na vhana vhahulwane kana musadzi/munna kha tax brackets dza fhasi, u nekedza tshelede i bvelelaho u bva kha trust uya kha vhone i badeliswa tax kha rate yayo (i nga vha 18% kana 26%), hu si 45%. Hezwi ndi income-splitting ya mulayo nahone i nga vhulunga tax khulwane ṅwaha muṅwe na muṅwe.
<p>SARS wants your certificates imported:
SARS i funa certificates dza anu u dzheniswa kha eFiling return ya anu. IRP5 / IT3(a): certificate ya salary ya mutsuri wanu, deductions na PAYE, i nekedzwaho mafheloni a ṅwaha. IT3(b): interest income u bva banka kana vhubindudzi zwa anu (fhasi ha 65, R23 800 ya u thoma ya interest ya ṅwaha a i badelisiwi tax). IT3(c): capital gains u bva shares, ETFs na unit trusts, u bva investment platform ya anu.

Kha eFiling, 'Import Certificate' i auto-populate return ya anu u bva kha zwine vhatsuri na zwiimiswa zwo rumela, fhedzi dzula ni tshi ṱola uri imported figures dzi fana na zwine na wana vhukuma, na u vhulunga zwithu zwa anu miṅwaha mi-ṱanu.

<p>SARS's position (confirmed in binding: Maimbelo a SARS (zwo tiwaho kha binding general rulings): crypto assets a si tshelede - ndi zwithu. Vhushaka hoṱhe ha crypto bui na mvelele dza tax. SARS yo ṋea ṋelangedzo ya uri ma-exchange a crypto a SA a fanela u rumela data ya vhushaka. U bula kha tax return ya anu ndi mulayo.
<p>SDL is 1% of the employer's payroll -: SDL ndi 1% ya payroll ya mutsuri - i badelwaho hi mutsuri uya kha SARS ṅwaha muṅwe na muṅwe. I fuda SETAs (Sector Education and Training Authorities) zwine zwa ṋea learnerships, apprenticeships, na bursaries. SDL ndi mutengo wa mutsuri - a i vhonali kha payslip ya anu. Fhedzi ni vhona vhuwa nga zwiimiswa zwa pfunzo zwa mutsuri zwine zwa tendelwa.
<p>See a debit order you never authorise:

  • Ni na miṅwaha ya 60 u bva ḓuvha ḽa debit u lwa nayo sa i si ya u tendelwa.

<p>Self-employed people pay tax twice ye:
Vhathu vhane vha shuma vha tshi ḓirangela vha badela tax kavhili nga ṅwaha: mafhelo a August na mafhelo a February. Arali na fhungudza nga u fhira 20% SARS i vhidza penalties na interest.

Nḓila ya vhutshilo: Vhulungani 25-35% ya tshelede iṅwe na iṅwe i wanalaho. Hei ndi tax bill ya anu ya vhumatshelu.
<p>Sell an asset (shares, property, unit:
Rengisani tshibveledzwa (shares, nnḓu, unit trusts, crypto) nga tshelede i fhiraho ya no renga nahone mibuelo ndi capital gain, i badelwaho nga CGT. Kha vhathu: R50 000 annual exclusion (ni vhala fhedzi gains zwi fhiraho), zwi tshi tevhelwa hi 40% inclusion rate (40% ya net gain i katelwa kha income ya anu ya tax). Kha top 45% marginal rate hezwi ndi 18% effective maximum.

Nnḓu ya anu ya vhukati i ṋewa exclusion ya R3 000 000 (2026/27), ngazwo vhanzhi a vha badeli CGT vha tshi rengisa nnḓu yabo. Tshivhuelelo: renga shares ka R50 000, rengisa ka R120 000 → R70 000 gain, hu tshi bviswa R50 000 exclusion = R20 000, 40% (R8 000) ya hone i katelwa kha income. <p>The <strong>FAIS Act (37 of 2002)</st: Mulayo wa FAIS (37 wa 2002) u tsireledza vhafazwi nga u langa vhuimo ha vhane vha neta vhufuluhi ha tshelede na mishumo ya u vhukati, hu si zwi bveledzwaho zwa vhuimo. <p>The <strong>Financial Advisory and In:

<p>The <strong>real interest rate</stron:

Tsumbo: A-kاونthi yaṋu ya vhulunga i badela 9%. Vhufuluhi ndi 5.5%. Vhuwelo haṋu ha vhukuma ndi 3.5%, heyi ndi ine thakha yaṋu i khou hula ngayo vhukuma.

Mitengo ya vhukuma ya u sa vha hone: Arali vhufuluhi vhu tshi fhira mutengo waṋu wa vhulunga, tshipitshi tshaṋu tshi a shaya ngeno ranti yaṋu i tshi hula. Nga 2020-2021, mitengo ya vhukuma ya Afurika Tshipembe yo vha i tsini na zero kana ya u sa vha hone, tshelede yo vha i tshi xelelwa nga vhuimo.

U fhafhara thakha ya tshifhinga tshilele, ni tea thakha ine ya fhirisa vhufuluhi tshifhinga tshi tshi ya. Heyi ndi nḓila ya ndeme ya vhubindudzi ha zwa equity u fhira u vhulunga zwoṱhe zwa tshelede.
<p>The <strong>repo rate</strong> is wha: Mutengo wa repo ndi zwine SARB i vhaea mabaṋki. Tsheo nthihi i tsutsumisa tshelede vhukati ha vhadeki na vhavhulungi. Mitengo i kwama vhufuluhi nga u fholisa u todana, na u swika hu swika na miṅwaha minzhi.
<p>The <strong>SARB repo rate</strong> d: Mutengo wa SARB repo u tsutsumisa mbadelo dzaṋu dza u adza. Prime = repo + 3.5%, na loani nzhi dza nnḓu zwi bva kha prime. <p>The most tax-efficient strategy for m:
Maano a mtengo mufuwo wa mutheo wa mufumisi wa kgwebo ya Pty Ltd:

  1. Ibadela mufuko u linganaho na ntha ya 31% bracket (approx R480 000/nwaha in 2024/25). Izwi zwi engedza RA deductions na med credits kha rate yo linganyelwaho.

Tshibvumio: Kgwebo i bveledza R1.2m phofiti. Badela R480 000 mufuko, konesa R132 000 kha RA (27.5%). Taxable salary = R348 000, tax ≈ R87 000. <p>The MPC meets <strong>six times a yea:
MPC i tangana miga thanu na mivhili nga nwaha i dovha ya vha na thomo nthihi ya vhundeme: u tsireledza CPI inflation kha 3-6% target band.

Musi inflation i tshi gonela nṱha ha 6%: MPC i nendisa repo rate. Rates dza nṱha dzi ita uri u adima hu dule, dzi fhungudza kushumisele kwa vhabebi, na u tsireledza inflation. Side effect: u kula ku a noka, vhuimo ha u sa vha na mishumo vhu nga nna.

Musi inflation i tshi wa kana u kula ku tshi fhungudzea: MPC i fhungudza repo rate. U adima ho leluwaho ku kokea kushumisele, vhubindudzi, na u kula ha ikonomi. Side effect: arali ya fhungudziwa nga vhuada, inflation i nga thoma hafhu.

MPC i fanela u sedza u langa inflation na u kula ha ikonomi, ndi trade-off nnyi na nnyi. SA's 2022-2024 rate hike cycle (from 3.5% to 8.25% over 18 months) ya vha yakona u huliswa nga maanda kha minwaha ya 15, yo thomiwa nga post-COVID supply shocks na global rate hikes.
<p>The phrase <strong>'guaranteed return:
Ipfi 'guaranteed returns' ndi tshiga tshine tsha vha na vhuine ha vhubindudzi ha vhuifhedzi. Tshibveledzwa tshi no fulufhedzisa mibuelo yo khwaṱhaho nṱha ha risk-free rate (tshifhingana tshi si gathi, tshi fanaho na interest rates) ndi ya vhuifhedzi ngauri mibuelo ya vhane ya bva afho i na vhuimo ha vhuifhedzi. Ponzi schemes 'guaranteed' by paying early investors with later investors' money, until they collapse.

U sedza: vhubindudzi hune ha netshelwa vhadzuloni vhu fanela u langwa nga FSCA-licensed provider. Sedza kha register ya FSCA at fsca.co.za u sa athu u vhea cent, na u vhiga scams to FSCA (0800 110 443).
<p>The pillars, to be met <strong>contin: Mishumo, ine ya tea u sikelwa nga tshifhinga tshoṱhe: vhu vhuḓi, u sa shanduka na vhuimo ho luga; vutsila; CPD; vhuimo ha u shuma; na vhuimo ha tshelede. A hu na thodea ya 'guaranteed returns', FAIS i langa kushumele.
Mitengo ya u renga ndi thomo fhedzi. Once-off: transfer duty (only above R1 210 000.
